figures.caption: Fire in Ink: header controls, three frequency bands, workspace tabs, macros and the selected Band chain.
Preset details let you edit descriptive tags and notes; factory edits are local metadata overrides.
The preset-lock manager lists available controls. Right-clicking the exact knob is the clearest way to identify which repeated module you are locking.
Sound Library: the Analog Drive collection contains 36 factory scenes. The star, removal control and pencil operate on library items.
The Routing panel combines channel selection, Serial/Parallel mode, branch assignment and Blend. Each branch uses the existing chain modules.
Warm Triode in Vintage: hardware illustration, local Shape controls and the selected band. Tube illumination responds to input level and Drive.
A digital Shape page shows its transfer view and asymmetry controls. The graph visualizes a curve, not the complete dynamic behavior of an analog model.
Tape Saturation has a moving transport display when processing audio. Its visual motion accompanies the selected model.
Master OTT uses the same LIFT / PRESS view as Band OTT. Its input, gain change and dynamic activity come from the selected OTT instance.
Master EQ: spectrum points and the selected point controls. Use the point navigation and type menu to edit the intended filter.
Dynamic controls belong to the selected Bell or Shelf point. Range determines the direction and maximum size of the gain movement.
An inserted Reverb offers an algorithm menu and Size, Damping, Pre-delay, Width, Low Cut and Mix.
The expanded Granular page contains the Clouds controls, Freeze and the Sample entry point.
After choosing a file, Sample previews the selected window and enables Import and Freeze. Normalize is optional and initially off.
A captured live recording can be exported from Sample. Start, Normalize and Import and Freeze remain unavailable until an import file has been selected.
The matrix shows source, destination and mapping controls. Several rows can target one parameter; their contributions are summed.
Mod Forge with a genuine editable triangle shape. Select an LFO in the rail, edit its curve, then assign destinations.
Playback sets Loop/Retrigger/One-shot, Shape or random waves, MIDI trigger filtering, and the random seed.
Each ENV has independent detector input and filtering. This example selects External sidechain; the host must actually route a signal to it.
Four MIDI CC slots can be configured explicitly or with Learn. They become modulation sources after the host delivers MIDI to Fire.
Settings provides appearance choices and locally copied diagnostics. This capture is from the documentation test host; your DAW and audio configuration will differ.
Paper uses a light background and fine-line controls. The processing and stored sound are unchanged.
Modern uses a dark digital interface. Vintage and Ink are illustrated elsewhere in this manual.
